title: Login Issues - Can't Access Account
description: Customer is unable to log in to their account. They've tried resetting their password multiple times but still can't access.

title: Page Load Error - Dashboard Not Displaying
description: Dashboard page does not load for some users, showing a blank screen or loading spinner indefinitely.

title: Payment Failed - Checkout Issue
description: Payments are failing for multiple users during checkout. Error code 402 appears on submission.

title: Password Reset Email Not Received
description: Customer requests a password reset but does not receive the email, even after multiple attempts.

title: Profile Picture Upload Fails
description: Uploading profile pictures results in an error for some users. The file size and format are correct.

title: Notification Settings Not Saving
description: Changes to notification preferences are not saved. Users report the settings revert to default after refreshing.

title: Search Function Returns No Results
description: Searching for existing tickets returns empty results for some users despite valid queries.

title: Unable to Download Invoice PDF
description: Clicking download for invoice PDF fails and displays an unknown error message.

title: Incorrect Total on Checkout
description: Cart shows incorrect total after applying discounts. Users are being charged wrong amounts.

title: Reset Password Fails with Error 403
description: Users trying to reset password receive a 403 error, preventing password update.

title: Slow Dashboard Loading
description: Dashboard page is loading very slowly for users, taking more than 30 seconds in some cases.

title: Form Submission Error
description: Submitting feedback forms returns an unknown error preventing users from submitting requests.

title: Missing Translations in Spanish Version
description: Some UI texts are not translated in Spanish, causing confusion for Spanish-speaking users.

title: Button Overlaps on Mobile
description: UI buttons overlap on mobile devices in portrait mode, making it hard to click.

title: Resolved/In Progress Ticket Count Mismatch
description: Banner counts for resolved and in-progress tickets do not match the actual tickets in the lists.
